question: Related Questions Q. I need your help in the subject matter in which i am going to narrate.please provide me the detail explanation. What is the verdict on using credit cards in the US? I know there is interest involved on those cards, but is it OK to still use them in a way that does not incur interest by making regular monthly payments. I ask this because credit cards help build the credit history in the US which become really important to do a lot of things simplest of which can be even renting an apartment. Not having credit card at all would mean lower credit history. I will appreciate your response on this. Also, some companies do not have interest like American Express where you have to pay all your expensed amount every month. But they still have late payment fees which they say is either $35 or 2.00% of the payment amount which ever is higher. Is this another form of interest? 2361 views Q. Assalamualaikum Brother Alhumdulillah you are doing a great job, May Allah bless you with all HIS bounties and Ikhlaas. I want to start a new business in the form of launching an advertising magazine. Its called Direct Mail advertising where you get adds from different companies, print them and deliver them directly to homes. In Tableegh we are taught that whatever you do, you might as well Ulemas opinion first. This magazine would most certainly involve printing pictures, because I am not the one making the add and I am just printing it, would that be wrong? Should I make it a rule that only adds without pictures will be printed? Secondly, I have heard in various Bayans that Beauty Salon culture is wrong, these magazines are actually run by various adds from different beauty salons offering makeup and haircuts, what should I do, completely not take any adds from Beauty salons? What about Fashion Designers making absolutely ridiculous clothes for women, would printing adds from fashion designers be wrong as well? A friend suggested that since people can wear Abayas and wudnt matter what they are wearing underneath therefore it would be okay to print adds for different Fashion Designers, what do you suggest? And then schools offering education, like Montessoris, where they don?t teach according to the Islamic Principles, do I take their adds? The thing is that it?s a pretty new idea in the town where I want to do this and I know it will work out inshallah, I just want to do it the way a Muslim would do his business. Assalamualaikum. 2434 views Q. Use of electric rocket 7272 views Q. Please, tell about illegal hawkers and illegal slums encroachment on roads in Mumbai in the light of Quran and Hadith. 1581 views Q. I work in a Govt. Arms and Ammunition manufacturing unit under Ministry of Defence. A system called 'Outgoing Circular' is effective in our organisation in which a person or a group of people apply for outgoing facility for events like Diwali, Ganesh jayanti, Ambedkar jayanti, Ramdhan any many more events where they go out of the factory getting one time punching exemption and not to return for the day under the pretext of doing welfare work . In turn they get their Overtime booked for the whole day and get the pay accodingly. This type of facility is also availed by our muslim brethren in the holy month of Ramadhan. I want to ask whether taking this facility is jayaz as the overtime pay is granted if the person works in the factory beyond 8 hours of normal working. Please reply my query. May Allah give us all hidayat. 2664 views Q. I am working in a Multinational company and there are various options to save the TAX. As per my understanding muslims are not supposed to pay any tax but since we are living in India and goverment impose us to pay tax so we pay them. There are various schemes available to save the TAX one of them is HOME LOAN. If i buy a Home with taking loan from bank then i gets rebate of 1.5 Lac of Income tax, the same amount 1.5 lac i can contribute to any poor peoples or charity if its saved. Is it allowed in our shariah to avail such benefits. Others are Life insurance, Mediclaim etc, Just for the sake of saving TAX and i don't have any intention to use the interest portion which i would recieve from policy. Jazaakumullah. 2564 views Q. KHUDA HAFIZ Question: Aslaam U Alaikum Wa Rehmatullahi Wa Barakatahu Respected Ulemas I would like to bring to your notice that in our India, a lot of piracy takes place and piracy is a kind of theft and it is considered illegal but still it takes palce, so I would like to clearly know about the following question in view of Islam that: What is your view regarding use of pirated operating systems and other softwares.Is it allowed or not in Islamic view? KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 8564 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2062/1648=H/1429) Theft is not allowed in these matters also. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
